checklist.answer: In Setup, search for App Manager, click New External Client App and fill in the basic information.
Salesforce now uses external client apps. New connected apps can no longer be created.
The form asks for a name, an API name and a contact email, and you choose a distribution state.
Under API (Enable OAuth Settings), tick Enable OAuth and enter your Callback URL.
On the Settings tab, open OAuth Settings and click Consumer Key and Secret. You verify your identity with a code sent by email, then copy the consumer key and, if it's required, the consumer secret.
Pick scopes in the OAuth Scopes section, such as api, web and refresh_token.
To distribute managed packages or API solutions on AgentExchange, they must pass Salesforce's security review.
Choose Local to develop an app for your own org, or Packaged to package and distribute it.
